The Daily Brief¶

The Daily Brief is a Django news application. Readers follow articles from publishers and independent journalists. Journalists write articles and newsletters. Editors review and approve articles; when an article is approved it is emailed to subscribers and logged through the project’s own REST endpoint, /api/approved/.
